'''Flabébé Blooms''' (Japanese: '''フラベベ、咲く''' ''{{tt|Flabebe|Flabébé}}, Bloom'') is the 580th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 32nd chapter of the {{MangaArc|X & Y}}.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* {{adv|Y}} and the Gym Leaders continue to try and keep the [[ultimate weapon]] from blooming.
* [[Bryony]] attacks the Gym Leaders to stop them from interfering with the ultimate weapon.
* [[Olympia]] tells {{adv|Trevor}}, {{adv|Tierno}}, and {{adv|Shauna}} to head to the ultimate weapon's control room.
* As they travel, Trevor's group meets with [[Clemont]] again.
* Trevor's group passes by the cell of [[AZ]], who was befriended by [[Emma]].
* AZ tells the group the story about how he fired the ultimate weapon after using it to revive his deceased {{p|Floette}}.
* After freeing AZ, Trevor's group arrives at the control room, where they find {{adv|X}} defeated.
* Trevor confronts [[Lysandre]] and attempts to remove the ultimate weapon's control room.
* Tierno and Shauna assist Trevor, but the ultimate weapon fires on Kalos despite them successfully removing the key.
* [[Xerxer|Xerneas]] tells AZ that despite the ultimate weapon firing, there is a human that it wishes to join forces with.
